itinerary.title: Arrival - HCM Shopping Tour
activities: Arrive Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN)
Wholesale Shopping Tour - Baju Kurung, Tudung, Telekung, Shoes & Bag

itinerary.title: Mekong River - Shopping & Food Tour
activities: Mekong Tour: Tien (Mekong) River Delta's Dragon, Unicorn, Tortoise and Phoenix Islands
Honey Bee-farm (Taste delicious honey tea with lemon)
Coconut candy workshop (Witness and try to do it)

itinerary.title: Chu Chi Tunnel - City - Shopping & Food Tour
activities: Chu Chi Tunnel Tour (Underground tunnel during Vietnam Wars)
Vietnam War Museum (The War Remnants Museum)
Central Post Office (Vietnam's largest post office)
Shopping Tour - Taka Plaza, Saigon Square

itinerary.title: Shopping Tour - Return KL
activities: Transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN)

expect.title: Attraction Places
expect.body: Attraction places may require a long journey to reach, 2 to 3 hours per way (Mekong River, Chu Chi Tunnel).

expect.title: Full Board Meals
expect.body: Meals are already included in the package. If you choose not to consume them, no refund will be provided.

expect.title: Lot of Walking
expect.body: Some attraction places will require a lot of walking (e.g. Chu Chi Tunnel).

expect.title: Hotel Locations
expect.body: Will prioritize near to city centre first. If not available, hotel location will be just outside the city center.

expect.title: Luggage Allocations
expect.body: Please bring max 1 luggage for 1 pax as it will affect the car capacity.
